user.title: Workout Tracker
user.description: Adds a Workout page to the sidebar. Everyone in your home gets their own profile, based on their Home Assistant user. Gym tracking is optional: pick your gym zone; each person's phone is found through their person entity.

data.days_per_week: Training days per week (your weekly target)
data.person: Person to track for this user (optional, picked automatically if empty)
data.owner: Your existing workout data belongs to

data_description.gym_zone: Create one first under Settings > Areas, labels & zones > Zones if you don't have it.
data_description.notify: auto = the tracked person's phone, off = none, or a notify action such as notify.mobile_app_my_phone.
data_description.owner: Every Home Assistant user gets their own profile. Any workouts already logged (e.g. from the earlier Pyscript version) go to this user. Others start fresh.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Workout Tracker is already set up. Use Configure to change its settings.
